title: sideritis arborescens var. antiatlantica
intro: Sideritis arborescens var. antiatlantica, commonly known as Rock Tea or White Rock Tea, is a plant species native to the Iberian Peninsula and the north of the Iberian Peninsula and the Pyrenees. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Sideritis arborescens var. antiatlantica include its ability to calm the nervous system and act as an adaptogen, helping the body to adapt to stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
